newsitem.title: USA: Milwaukee Land sets distribution payout.
newsitem.headline: Milwaukee Land sets distribution payout.

text.p: The board of Milwaukee Land Co said Wednesday its board will make a distribution on January 3, 1997 of $1.25 per Class A unit to unitholders of record December 31.

It said this action is in line with Milwaukee Land's previously announced intention to cause Heartland Partners LP, Milwaukee Land's general partner, to make a distribution to unitholders once it closed on and received proceeds from the sale of two parcels of land on Goose Island in Chicago.

Milwaukee Land said it expects that the $0.75 per unit balance of the proposed $2 per unit distribution will be paid following the closing from the second parcel of land, which is expected during the second quarter of 1997.
